headline: Two changes this session. (1) Per-role to-dos + notes on Queue cards: each job gains an optional todos[] checklist and a notes string (additive Job fields — no Supabase migration, old records read as [] / ''); a compact summary chip (✓ done/total + note icon) toggles a Reveal panel with an HDS checklist (add/toggle/delete, strikethrough when done, one-click starter tasks) + on-blur Notes textarea, all through the existing updateJob → localStorage + Supabase path; pure helpers in src/todos.ts with table-driven tests. (2) Retired the MUI-shaped adapters: ui/Button, ui/Dialog, ui/Tooltip, ui/Alert, ui/TextField deleted and all ~34 call sites across 12 files migrated to real HDS directly (Button variant/tone, compound Dialog, HdsTooltip, Alert+dismiss, Input/Textarea). src/ui is now purely the layout gap (box.tsx + Reveal) — the only remaining non-HDS UI, earmarked to route upstream (docs/hds-upstream-asks-0.9.md §9). Typecheck + lint + all 153 tests + build green; verified all three dialogs + Queue render desktop + 390px.
